name: Pro Planet P3 Pro
summary: A. O. Smith ProPlanet P3 Pro is an advanced 8-stage RO water purifier with Silver Charged Membrane Technology (SCMT) that delivers 100% RO purified, baby-safe water .
intro: The A. O. Smith ProPlanet P3 Pro features 8-stage RO + Silver Charged Membrane Technology (SCMT) to deliver 100% RO purified, baby-safe water. Equipped with Advanced Recovery Technology™, it saves 2X more water than conventional RO purifiers. Its Copper Fortified Mineralizer, 5-star water-saving performance, digital Intelli-Display, and wall/tabletop installation make it an efficient and convenient choice for modern homes.

rows: Copper Fortified Mineralizer, Digital Display, Intelli-Display, Night Assist
